text: FMAX file verification error Required installation files may be missing or corrupted, or files from different versions may have been mixed together. Reinstall using FMAX-setup.exe from getfmax.com. Keep all files in the installation folder together rather than moving fmax.exe on its own. If this message appears while FMAX is running, stop making new edits and follow FMAX's prompts to close the app. When reinstalling, do not check "Delete application data" so your settings and lists stay intact. FMAX won't connect to the game Click the connection indicator in the top-right corner of the window to see the current status and what to do next. Status Message What to do FM27 closed FM27 is not running Launch the game and load a save. FMAX connects automatically. FM27 starting The game is still starting up Once the game reaches the main menu, FMAX connects automatically. Waiting for save No save loaded yet Load a save and FMAX will read it automatically. Version mismatch Unsupported game version See When Version mismatch appears below. No access Can’t open the game If you ran the game as administrator, run FMAX as administrator too (right-click the FMAX icon → Run as administrator). Error Something went wrong while reading the game Wait a moment, then click Check again in the Connection status popover. If it keeps happening, send a developer log. In the Connection status popover, Check again (shown when disconnected) searches for the game again, and Reload from game (shown when connected) refreshes the lists from the game. When Version mismatch appears FMAX only reads and writes to the original FM27 27.0.1+2503222 files, or that exact version patched with the DoF patcher. It checks game_plugin.dll in your game folder. If that file doesn't match, the connection indicator shows Version mismatch , a Different game version card appears on the left, and FMAX neither reads from nor writes to the game. There are three possible causes: 1. game_plugin.dll was changed while the game was running. Restart the game. 2. Another patch or skin add-on modified game_plugin.dll . If the Connection status popover says Game file modified by another mod , click Turn on compatibility mode or enable Compatibility mode in Settings. Only the FMAX features that conflict with that patch are turned off, while everything else works as usual. If FMAX still won't connect in Compatibility mode, remove the patch and restore the original file. If you aren't sure how to undo the patch, right-click FM27 in your Steam Library → Properties → Installed Files → Verify integrity of game files to restore the original files, then relaunch the game. 3. FM27 itself updated to a newer build. You'll need a new FMAX release updated for the new game version before FMAX can connect. Verifying integrity resets every game installation file modified by any patch back to the original—not just game_plugin.dll . If you applied the DoF patcher, that will be undone too. Anything outside the game installation folder, such as skins in your Documents folder, is left untouched. Stuck on the startup screen If the startup screen doesn't finish when launching FMAX, it shows the reason along with action buttons. Message Meaning Couldn’t load game structure data FMAX couldn't open its own data files. Restart FMAX. FMAX stopped while starting up Startup or game detection didn't finish within 20 seconds. Restart FMAX. Other messages Same meaning as in the connection status table above. - Try again: Reopens the FMAX interface from scratch if it stopped during Preparing FMAX, or searches for the game again if it stopped while finding or reading the game. - Save log · Copy log: Captures a log to send to the developer. See Sending a developer log below. - Continue anyway: Dismisses the startup screen and opens the main list view. If FMAX keeps stopping in the same place, please save the log and send it to the developer. Lists or tabs are empty Message What to do Couldn’t read the list Click the connection indicator in the top right and click Reload from game . No matching items Your search query or filters excluded everything. Try changing your search or filters. Couldn’t read values · Couldn’t find this player in the game If you reloaded your save, click Reload on the tab. Not connected to the game This screen was opened without a game connection. Open it inside the FMAX app to read values from FM27. If numbers in lists or search results look wrong after advancing the in-game date, click Reload from game to read the lists fresh. Tactic files don't show up in the list Tactic Arena, the Tactics screen, and Lock AI manager tactics in Live tweaks all list the tactic files (.fmf) inside your game's tactics folder. If a tactic you saved on FM's tactics screen isn't listed, the game may be saving files somewhere else (for instance, if you changed your user data location in game settings, or your Documents folder lives on another drive or in OneDrive). Look at the Tactics folder line in any tactic picker to see which folder FMAX is currently reading and how it found it.
